about_the_game:
TCG Master Trader is a free to play card-collecting experience where every few hours brings new surprises and new cards to discover!

Real Time Based Drops

Every 4 hours, players can claim a fresh pack of 5 random cards, added straight to their personal collection.

Card drops are real time-based, meaning the timer counts down even while the game is closed — you don’t need to be online or actively playing.

Just come back to claim your rewards… or enable Auto-Claim to receive your packs automatically!

During special events or promotions, drop intervals may change or include bonus packs. To be the first to know when that happens, join our official Discord community.

Card Collection & Binder

Card Binder: Dive into your binder to browse your collection, examine your cards, and enjoy the unique designs and visual styles of each pull.

There are 144 unique base cards, but with multiple styles, borders, and foils, there’s a total of 1,728 cards to collect, and more to come!

Drop Rates & Customization

Each pack contains 5 randomly generated cards with a random rarity, border, foil and art type. Here’s what you can expect:

Card Rarities:

  • Common – 70%

  • Uncommon – 20.71%

  • Rare – 8.28%

  • Epic – 1%

  • Legendary – 0.01%

Border Styles:

  • Basic – 80%

  • Gold – 17%

  • Radiant – 3%

Art Versions:

  • Standard – 90%

  • Full Art – 10%

Foil Variants:

  • Non-Foiled – 95%

  • Foiled – 5%

Marketplace Freedom

All cards in your collection can be listed on the Steam Community Market! You can freely buy and sell cards with other players to build your binder, hunt for rare variants, or simply manage your growing collection however you like.

Key Highlights

• Free card packs every 4 hours – Always something new to look forward to.

• Fully interactive card binder – Organize, admire, and display your collection.

• Deep customization possibilities – Rarities, borders, art styles, and foils.

• Steam Market integration – Buy and sell with players worldwide.

• 1,728 collectible card variations – Will you collect them all?

Join the Collection Craze

Whether you're a casual collector, a hardcore completionist, or just love the thrill of opening card packs, TCG Master Trader is the perfect place to build your ultimate card collection.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i7 4770
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
